headline: Apple releases iOS 27.0.1, fixing Face ID and freezing bugs
summary: Apple released iOS 27.0.1, the first update to iOS 27, fixing a bug that caused the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max to freeze or restart when using Face ID. Engadget also reports the update addresses touchscreen issues.
